answer: A stake-bonded vault makes Sybil attacks expensive: every agent identity must lock a deposit in a shared vault before it can earn reputation, so creating a hundred fake identities costs a hundred deposits. Honest agents climb a terrace of trust tiers as their locked stake and verified work history grow, unlocking higher-value tasks, while a detected cheat forfeits its deposit and is saffron-flagged in the public record for all to see. One honest identity is cheap; an army of fakes pays full price for each.
